# Lower Belvedere

Today 10 am - 6 pm

![Lower Belvedere](https://www.belvedere.at/sites/default/files/styles/full_width/public/2025-05/UB_Nord%2020250513-1.jpg.webp?itok=7LqD_nf3) 

Art exhibitions from all periods at the former residential palace of Prince Eugene and at the Orangery.   
Treasures from the Middle Ages await you in the Palace Stables.

## Current Exhibitions 

- [**Erika Giovanna Klien**](https://www.belvedere.at/en/erika-giovanna-klien) — All Is Movement — 18 September 2026 - 31 January 2027 — Exhibition — Lower Belvedere
- [**Erna Rosenstein**](https://www.belvedere.at/en/erna-rosenstein) — On the Other Side of Silence — 3 July 2026 - 10 January 2027 — Exhibition — Lower Belvedere
- [**Gallery Middle Ages and Renaissance**](https://www.belvedere.at/en/study-collection-middle-ages-and-renaissance) — Ongoing — Exhibition — Lower Belvedere

## Getting there 

**Route Planner**

We encourage you to go green when planning your visit: the Belvedere is easily reached by public transportation, and offers as well a charging station for electric cars, a city bike station, and bicycle racks in the immediate vicinity.

**Contact**

##### Information Desk 

T: [+43 1 795 57-0](tel:+43179557-0)

E-Mail: [**info@belvedere.at**](mailto:info@belvedere.at)

**Address**

Rennweg 6, 1030 Vienna

**Public Transport**

**Tram 71**  
Station "Unteres Belvedere"  
**Tram D**  
Station "Gußhaustraße"

**Bike**

Bike parking at the Rennweg entrance

**Car**

Discounted parking for a time of 6 hours is offered by the BIP Garage at Palais Schwarzenberg and the BIP Garage Schwarzenbergplatz. Note: This discount does not apply with the parking app.

## Gardens 

- [**Gardens**](https://www.belvedere.at/en/belvedere/gardens) — The Belvedere’s garden is one of Europe’s most significant historical gardens and is a fine example of late Baroque garden design.
